behavior_by_action.ASK_PERMISSION: Ask one direct permission question before offering advice.
behavior_by_action.GIVE_DIRECT_STEPS: Provide concrete next steps immediately without asking permission first.
behavior_by_action.USE_CONCISE_DETAIL: Render task content in no more than three short sentences.
behavior_by_action.USE_EXPANDED_DETAIL: Render task content with rationale and at least three supporting details.
behavior_by_action.USE_GENTLE_PRIVATE: Use gentle wording and frame sensitive feedback for a private channel.
behavior_by_action.USE_DIRECT_TONE: State the main feedback directly in the first sentence.
behavior_by_action.USE_UNPERSONALIZED_DEFAULT: Respond using only current-turn information and generic task norms; do not personalize from persistent memory.
